items.justification: Encryption of personal data in transit versus communication of unresolvable threats downstream.
Replaceability of cryptographic primitives versus sharing test findings with operators.
Local operation during network loss versus the required content of model documentation.
Alerting on detected software tampering versus awareness of prohibited use cases.
Both constitute coordinated vulnerability handling; A obliges timely action on reports, B the published policy and route by which they arrive.
Verifying update authenticity versus the use of independent security testers.
Cryptography for secure communication versus accessible user guidance.
